about.en: XLU is the Utilities Select Sector SPDR Fund (now marketed as the State Street Utilities Select Sector SPDR ETF), an exchange-traded fund sponsored by State Street Global Advisors that tracks the Utilities Select Sector Index, representing electric, gas, water and independent power utilities within the S&P 500. Its shares trade on NYSE Arca as XLU, and derivative markets quote the same fund under the XLU ticker.
